description: Spin-parity object for nuclear levels.  It takes the form of an array, with each element of the array being a possible spin-parity.  Spins are tracked as 'twice spin' so that they are integer-valued.  Both spin and parity can be marked as tentative.

stringRepresentation.description: This is the ASCII representation of the spin-parity object, similar to what would be printed in Nuclear Data Sheets.

relativeTo.description: This spin is relative to that of another level.  For example, J+2 would be expressed as { 'twoTimesSpin': 4, 'relativeTo': { 'label': 'J' }.

approximateValue.description: For cases when the relative value of the spin is approximately known.  Should follow the twiceSpin convention.
